decisions.reason: As a 2023 launch close to the firm’s established equipment range, in a growing industry and backed by visible market introduction, management is likely to continue it and treat any early weakness as normal ramp-up.
This articulated dumper extends the core construction offer, so prior engineering and launch commitments make withdrawal within a year unlikely absent clear failure evidence.

Although more distant from the established range and therefore somewhat more vulnerable, it still fits the firm’s specialist underground-vehicle identity and escalation of commitment makes management inclined to give it more time.

A telescopic loader line with several models represents the strongest investment and public commitment within the core business, so management would be especially reluctant to remove it soon after launch.
